response.sql: WITH large_orders AS (SELECT k_symbol, amount FROM "order" WHERE amount >= 2802), purpose_averages AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) as purpose_avg FROM large_orders GROUP BY k_symbol), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(purpose_avg) as overall_avg FROM purpose_averages) SELECT pa.k_symbol, pa.purpose_avg, pa.purpose_avg - oa.overall_avg as exceeds FROM purpose_averages pa, overall_average oa WHERE pa.purpose_avg > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY pa.k_symbol;

assumptions.assumption: The amount 2802 is an inclusive cutoff: orders with amount >= 2802 are treated as large orders.

alternatives.interpretation: The amount 2802 is an exclusive cutoff: only orders with amount > 2802 are treated as large orders.
